project: AnalogFit - 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge (Team H.E.N.K.)

_how_to_read.targets.observables_target: Illustrative values except L (idealized computed solar geometry). At run time, science.py loads verified NASA LOLA/MOLA 500 m slope from preserved PDS byte slices. Only supported Earth AND target features enter evidence mode.
_how_to_read.targets.tolerances_sigma: How far an Earth value may be from the target before the match fades (Gaussian width, same unit as the feature).
_how_to_read.task_weights: How much each feature matters for each kind of test. Each row sums to 1.
_how_to_read.regime_flags_v_tau: Heuristic flags for displaying physical differences. The legacy numerical multiplier is not a calibrated physical ceiling.
_how_to_read.contamination_anchors: Where vegetation, rain and night lights start (bare) and finish (saturated) disqualifying a site.

features.S: Slope: median ground slope over a 100 m baseline (degrees)
features.R: Roughness: ln of RMS height change over 100 m, plus the Hurst exponent
features.M: Mineralogy: proportions of 11 mineral groups, compared with Jensen-Shannon divergence
features.G: Grain size: ln of the median grain diameter in micrometres
features.L: Sun-grazing time: share of the best 10-day window with the Sun 0-5 degrees above the horizon
features.D: Dust lifting: fraction of time wind exceeds the threshold that lifts grains

T1.name: Lunar south pole, Connecting Ridge and Shackleton rim

S.source: Illustrative value. Needs LOLA 100 m slope statistics for the ridge.

R.source: Illustrative value. Needs LOLA roughness and Hurst exponent.

B.source: Illustrative value. Needs Mini-RF S-band CPR.

M.source: Illustrative value. Needs M3 / Diviner mineralogy.

G.source: Illustrative value. Needs regolith grain-size data.

I.source: Illustrative value. Needs Diviner ice-stability or LEND/LAMP volatile maps.

L.source: Ridge crests near Shackleton are sunlit roughly 80-90% of the year with the Sun always within about 2 deg of the horizon (Mazarico et al. 2011; Speyerer & Robinson 2013). Approximate.

S.source: Illustrative value. Needs LOLA / LROC NAC DTM slope around the pit.

B.source: Illustrative value. Needs Mini-RF S-band CPR.

M.source: Illustrative value. Needs M3 mare basalt mineralogy.

G.source: Illustrative value. Needs mare regolith grain-size data.

L.source: Solar geometry at the site latitude with the body's obliquity (same formula as for Earth).

S.source: Illustrative value. Needs MOLA / HRSC 100 m slope statistics.

M.source: Illustrative value. Needs TES / CRISM mineralogy.

G.source: Illustrative value. Needs thermal-inertia-derived grain size.

I.source: Illustrative value. Needs SWIM ice-consistency value.

L.source: Solar geometry at the site latitude with the body's obliquity (same formula as for Earth).

T.source: Mars average surface temperature, about 210 K (NASA NSSDC Mars Fact Sheet). Global mean, not site-specific; replace with a TES or Mars Climate Database value for Arcadia.

D.source: Illustrative value. Needs dust-lifting statistics from a Mars climate model.

solar_geometry._note: Used for the low-sun lighting feature (L): share of time the Sun sits 0-5 deg above the horizon in the best 10-day window. Same formula on every body; no terrain, no refraction.

S.plain_en: How steep the ground is, measured over 100 m. Decides whether a lander or rover can operate.
S.plain_id: Seberapa curam permukaan tanah, diukur per 100 m. Menentukan apakah pendarat atau rover bisa beroperasi.

R.plain_en: Typical height difference between two points 100 m apart: bumpy or smooth terrain.
R.plain_id: Beda tinggi khas antara dua titik berjarak 100 m: medan bergelombang atau rata.

B.plain_en: Radar circular polarization ratio. High values mean many fist-sized rocks, or ice.
B.plain_id: Rasio polarisasi sirkular radar. Nilai tinggi berarti banyak batu seukuran kepalan, atau es.

M.plain_en: How closely the mix of minerals resembles the target's.
M.plain_id: Seberapa mirip campuran mineralnya dengan lokasi target.

G.plain_en: Typical size of soil grains. Controls how wheels sink and how dust behaves.
G.plain_id: Ukuran khas butir tanah. Mengatur seberapa dalam roda terbenam dan perilaku debu.

I.plain_en: Chance that the ground holds ice near the surface.
I.plain_id: Peluang adanya es di dekat permukaan tanah.

L.plain_en: Share of time the Sun sits just above the horizon (0-5 deg) during the best 10 days of the year. Long shadows are the main hazard for cameras at the lunar pole.
L.plain_id: Porsi waktu matahari berada tepat di atas cakrawala (0-5 derajat) pada 10 hari terbaik dalam setahun. Bayangan panjang adalah tantangan utama kamera di kutub Bulan.

T.plain_en: Yearly average temperature of the ground.

D.plain_en: Share of time the wind is strong enough to lift soil grains.
D.plain_id: Porsi waktu angin cukup kuat untuk mengangkat butir tanah.
D.earth_source: MERRA-2 wind (NASA POWER) with placeholder grain size

Landing: hazard detection.plain_en: Testing cameras and lidar that spot rocks and slopes during descent.
Landing: hazard detection.plain_id: Menguji kamera dan lidar yang mengenali batu dan lereng saat turun.
Landing: hazard detection.limit_en: Depends on terrain shape and lighting, which Earth can match. No physics limit.
Landing: hazard detection.limit_id: Bergantung pada bentuk medan dan cahaya, yang bisa ditiru Bumi. Tanpa batas fisika.

Landing: plume and touchdown.plain_en: Testing how engine exhaust blasts soil at touchdown.
Landing: plume and touchdown.plain_id: Menguji bagaimana semburan mesin menghamburkan tanah saat mendarat.
Landing: plume and touchdown.limit_en: Exhaust spreads and dust flies very differently without air and under low gravity.
Landing: plume and touchdown.limit_id: Semburan dan debu bergerak sangat berbeda tanpa udara dan pada gravitasi rendah.

Navigation.plain_en: Testing how a rover or astronaut finds the way using cameras.
Navigation.plain_id: Menguji cara rover atau astronaut mencari jalan dengan kamera.
Navigation.limit_en: Depends on terrain shape and lighting, which Earth can match. No physics limit.
Navigation.limit_id: Bergantung pada bentuk medan dan cahaya, yang bisa ditiru Bumi. Tanpa batas fisika.

Mobility.plain_en: Testing how wheels grip, sink and climb.
Mobility.plain_id: Menguji cengkeraman, amblas, dan daya tanjak roda.
Mobility.limit_en: Soil carries weight differently: Earth's gravity is 6 times the Moon's and 2.6 times Mars's.
Mobility.limit_id: Tanah menahan beban secara berbeda: gravitasi Bumi 6 kali Bulan dan 2,6 kali Mars.

Robotics.plain_en: Testing robot arms that dig, grab and place.
Robotics.plain_id: Menguji lengan robot untuk menggali, mengambil, dan meletakkan.
Robotics.limit_en: Arm loads and reaction forces scale with gravity.
Robotics.limit_id: Beban lengan dan gaya reaksi mengikuti gravitasi.

Construction.plain_en: Testing how to build pads, berms and shelters from local soil.
Construction.plain_id: Menguji pembangunan landasan, tanggul, dan pelindung dari tanah setempat.
Construction.limit_en: Soil flow, heat transfer in sintering and outgassing all change with gravity and air pressure.
Construction.limit_id: Aliran tanah, perpindahan panas saat sintering, dan pelepasan gas berubah karena gravitasi dan tekanan udara.

ISRU.plain_en: Testing how to extract water and oxygen from the ground.
ISRU.plain_id: Menguji ekstraksi air dan oksigen dari tanah.
ISRU.limit_en: Ice sublimates instead of melting in vacuum, and separation by settling depends on gravity.
ISRU.limit_id: Es menyublim, bukan mencair, di ruang hampa, dan pemisahan dengan pengendapan bergantung pada gravitasi.

Thermal/hardware endurance.plain_en: Testing whether hardware survives the temperature swings.
Thermal/hardware endurance.plain_id: Menguji apakah perangkat bertahan terhadap perubahan suhu.
Thermal/hardware endurance.limit_en: Earth's air cools hardware by convection, which barely exists on the Moon or Mars.
Thermal/hardware endurance.limit_id: Udara Bumi mendinginkan perangkat lewat konveksi, yang nyaris tidak ada di Bulan atau Mars.

Human ops: procedures.plain_en: Rehearsing planning, sampling and teamwork with crews.
Human ops: procedures.plain_id: Melatih perencanaan, pengambilan sampel, dan kerja tim bersama kru.
Human ops: procedures.limit_en: Procedures do not depend on gravity or air. No physics limit.
Human ops: procedures.limit_id: Prosedur tidak bergantung pada gravitasi atau udara. Tanpa batas fisika.

Human ops: suit/physiology.plain_en: Testing spacesuits and the human body at work.
Human ops: suit/physiology.plain_id: Menguji baju antariksa dan tubuh manusia saat bekerja.
Human ops: suit/physiology.limit_en: Suit pressure, walking in low gravity and radiation dose cannot be reproduced outdoors on Earth.
Human ops: suit/physiology.limit_id: Tekanan baju, berjalan di gravitasi rendah, dan dosis radiasi tidak bisa ditiru di alam terbuka Bumi.
